notes_for_editor: Thinnest record of the three: no build date, staffing, owner or removal information found. The Nicolet National Forest history chapter 7 (npshistory.com) has no tower mentions. Two Forest Service PDFs (stelprd3843401, stelprdb5425988) timed out with HTTP 504 and were not read; they may hold Nicolet fire-lookout history and are worth retrying. The Anvil Lake Campground Shelter in Eagle River is a different structure and is used only for disambiguation. The story is about 130 words; the 2024 statewide sentences are the only content beyond location, agency and the shelter note, because no source adds tower-specific history. Statewide figures are context only. Suggested next steps: Nicolet ranger district records and Vilas County historical records.
